title: Cloud Code disrupts Open Cloud setup #cloudcode #opencloud #agentautomation
description:
Cloud Code replaced the need for Open Cloud by rebuilding the same remote agent workflow natively, without self-hosting or relying on an unvetted skills marketplace. The setup centers on local execution, mobile access, and persistent background automation.

The workflow uses Cloud Code on Mac, the Cloud Mobile app for remote control, and messaging channels like iMessage, Telegram, or Discord to start tasks with full project context. That removes the need to open tabs or terminals while keeping the agent tied directly to your existing machine and session.

The key advantage is always-on automation with safer controls. Scheduled slash loops and monitor tools can run 24/7, handle overnight work, and check before risky actions, making the system more practical for developers who want continuous output without exposing projects to the security and reliability issues associated with Open Cloud.
